title: Bugatti Veyron vs Chiron: The Real Difference
description:
The Bugatti Chiron is the successor to the Bugatti Veyron, and on the surface it is the same recipe: an eight litre, sixteen cylinder, four-turbo engine in a carbon car that costs millions. So what actually changed? We went through Wikipedia, Bugatti's own press release, Carscoops, Top Gear, Car magazine and Motor One, and the answer is both bigger and smaller than you would expect. Here are the numbers, side by side, with every claim sourced. We compare the engines, the power, the weight, the speed, the efficiency, the price and the production runs. When a figure is a manufacturer's claim, we say so. When two sources disagree, we show both. And where the numbers need arithmetic, the arithmetic is ours and it is labelled. At the end, we tell you what the sources do not say.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
